item.title: MapQuest will now show you where Flock cameras are in your neighborhood
item.description:
📝 News Apps MapQuest will now show you where Flock cameras are in your neighborhood You can see the locations of known outdoor surveillance cameras in the app. You can toggle a layer that shows known outdoor surveillance cameras and license plate readers. The layer will show you where Flock cameras are.
🔗 Read more: https://www.engadget.com/2288729/mapquest-will-now-show-you-where-flock-cameras-are-in-your-neighborhood/
